title: Physics equations
subject: Physics
syllabus: Cambridge International AS & A Level Physics (9702)
description: Every key equation as a word equation, with its symbol form alongside.

items.prompt: Write the word equation for speed.
items.answer: speed = distance / time

items.prompt: Write the word equation for velocity.
items.answer: velocity = displacement / time

items.prompt: Write the word equation for acceleration.
items.answer: acceleration = change in velocity / time taken

items.prompt: Write the word equation for v = u + at.
items.answer: final velocity = initial velocity + acceleration x time

items.prompt: Write the word equation for s = ut + ½at².
items.answer: displacement = initial velocity x time + 1/2 x acceleration x time squared

items.prompt: Write the word equation for v² = u² + 2as.
items.answer: final velocity squared = initial velocity squared + 2 x acceleration x displacement

items.prompt: Write the word equation for s = ½(u + v)t.
items.answer: displacement = 1/2 x (initial velocity + final velocity) x time

items.prompt: Write the word equation for force, mass and acceleration.
items.answer: force = mass x acceleration

items.prompt: Write the word equation for weight.
items.answer: weight = mass x gravitational field strength

items.prompt: Write the word equation for momentum.
items.answer: momentum = mass x velocity

items.prompt: Write the word equation for force and momentum.
items.answer: force = change in momentum / time taken

items.prompt: Write the word equation for density.
items.answer: density = mass / volume

items.prompt: Write the word equation for pressure.
items.answer: pressure = force / area

items.prompt: Write the word equation for hydrostatic pressure.
items.answer: change in pressure = density x gravitational field strength x change in depth

items.prompt: Write the word equation for upthrust.
items.answer: upthrust = density of fluid x gravitational field strength x volume displaced

items.prompt: Write the word equation for moment of a force.
items.answer: moment = force x perpendicular distance from the pivot

items.prompt: Write the word equation for torque of a couple.
items.answer: torque = one of the forces x perpendicular distance between the forces

items.prompt: Write the word equation for work done.
items.answer: work done = force x displacement in the direction of the force

items.prompt: Write the word equation for kinetic energy.
items.answer: kinetic energy = 1/2 x mass x speed squared

items.prompt: Write the word equation for gravitational potential energy.
items.answer: change in gravitational potential energy = mass x gravitational field strength x change in height

items.prompt: Write the word equation for power.
items.answer: power = work done / time taken

items.prompt: Write the word equation for power and velocity.
items.answer: power = force x velocity

items.prompt: Write the word equation for efficiency.
items.answer: efficiency = useful energy output / total energy input x 100%

items.prompt: Write the word equation for stress.
items.answer: stress = force / cross-sectional area

items.prompt: Write the word equation for strain.
items.answer: strain = extension / original length

items.prompt: Write the word equation for Young modulus.
items.answer: Young modulus = stress / strain

items.prompt: Write the word equation for Hooke's law.
items.answer: force = spring constant x extension

items.prompt: Write the word equation for elastic potential energy.
items.answer: elastic potential energy = 1/2 x force x extension

items.prompt: Write the word equation for wave speed.
items.answer: wave speed = frequency x wavelength

items.prompt: Write the word equation for frequency and period.
items.answer: frequency = 1 / period

items.prompt: Write the word equation for intensity.
items.answer: intensity = power / area

items.prompt: Write the word equation for intensity and amplitude.
items.answer: intensity is proportional to amplitude squared

items.prompt: Write the word equation for Doppler effect.
items.answer: observed frequency = source frequency x wave speed / (wave speed +- source speed)

items.prompt: Write the word equation for double-slit interference.
items.answer: wavelength = slit separation x fringe separation / distance from slits to screen

items.prompt: Write the word equation for diffraction grating.
items.answer: grating spacing x sin(angle) = order x wavelength

items.prompt: Write the word equation for charge.
items.answer: charge = current x time

items.prompt: Write the word equation for current and drift velocity.
items.answer: current = cross-sectional area x number density x drift velocity x charge

items.prompt: Write the word equation for potential difference.
items.answer: potential difference = energy transferred / charge

items.prompt: Write the word equation for resistance.
items.answer: resistance = potential difference / current

items.prompt: Write the word equation for electrical power.
items.answer: power = potential difference x current

items.prompt: Write the word equation for power from current and resistance.
items.answer: power = current squared x resistance

items.prompt: Write the word equation for power from p.d. and resistance.
items.answer: power = potential difference squared / resistance

items.prompt: Write the word equation for resistivity.
items.answer: resistance = resistivity x length / cross-sectional area

items.prompt: Write the word equation for resistors in series.
items.answer: total resistance = sum of the individual resistances

items.prompt: Write the word equation for resistors in parallel.
items.answer: 1 / total resistance = sum of 1 / each individual resistance

items.prompt: Write the word equation for e.m.f. and internal resistance.
items.answer: e.m.f. = terminal potential difference + current x internal resistance

items.prompt: Write the word equation for potential divider.
items.answer: output voltage = input voltage x R2 / (R1 + R2)

items.prompt: Write the word equation for angle in radians.
items.answer: angle in radians = arc length / radius

items.prompt: Write the word equation for angular speed.
items.answer: angular speed = 2 x pi / period

items.prompt: Write the word equation for speed and angular speed.
items.answer: speed = angular speed x radius

items.prompt: Write the word equation for centripetal acceleration.
items.answer: centripetal acceleration = speed squared / radius

items.prompt: Write the word equation for centripetal force.
items.answer: centripetal force = mass x speed squared / radius

items.prompt: Write the word equation for gravitational field strength.
items.answer: gravitational field strength = force / mass

items.prompt: Write the word equation for Newton's law of gravitation.
items.answer: gravitational force = G x mass 1 x mass 2 / distance squared

items.term: Field strength of a point mass
items.prompt: Write the word equation for field strength of a point mass.
items.answer: gravitational field strength = G x mass / distance squared

items.prompt: Write the word equation for gravitational potential.
items.answer: gravitational potential = - G x mass / distance

items.prompt: Write the word equation for gravitational potential energy (field).
items.answer: gravitational potential energy = - G x mass 1 x mass 2 / distance

items.prompt: Write the word equation for specific heat capacity.
items.answer: thermal energy = mass x specific heat capacity x change in temperature

items.prompt: Write the word equation for specific latent heat.
items.answer: thermal energy = mass x specific latent heat

items.prompt: Write the word equation for Kelvin and Celsius.
items.answer: temperature in kelvin = temperature in degrees Celsius + 273.15

items.prompt: Write the word equation for ideal gas equation (moles).
items.answer: pressure x volume = amount in moles x molar gas constant x thermodynamic temperature

items.prompt: Write the word equation for ideal gas equation (molecules).
items.answer: pressure x volume = number of molecules x Boltzmann constant x thermodynamic temperature

items.prompt: Write the word equation for pressure from kinetic theory.
items.answer: pressure = 1/3 x number of molecules x mass of a molecule x mean square speed / volume

items.term: Mean kinetic energy of a molecule
items.prompt: Write the word equation for mean kinetic energy of a molecule.
items.answer: mean kinetic energy of a molecule = 3/2 x Boltzmann constant x thermodynamic temperature

items.prompt: Write the word equation for boltzmann constant.
items.answer: Boltzmann constant = molar gas constant / Avogadro constant

items.prompt: Write the word equation for first law of thermodynamics.
items.answer: increase in internal energy = heating of the system + work done on the system

items.term: Work done on or by a gas
items.prompt: Write the word equation for work done on or by a gas.
items.answer: work done = pressure x change in volume

items.prompt: Write the word equation for simple harmonic motion.
items.answer: acceleration = - angular frequency squared x displacement

items.prompt: Write the word equation for angular frequency.
items.answer: angular frequency = 2 x pi x frequency

items.prompt: Write the word equation for displacement in s.h.m..
items.answer: displacement = amplitude x sin(angular frequency x time)

items.prompt: Write the word equation for speed in s.h.m..
items.answer: speed = angular frequency x square root of (amplitude squared - displacement squared)

items.prompt: Write the word equation for total energy in s.h.m..
items.answer: total energy = 1/2 x mass x angular frequency squared x amplitude squared

items.prompt: Write the word equation for electric field strength.
items.answer: electric field strength = force / charge

items.prompt: Write the word equation for uniform electric field.
items.answer: electric field strength = potential difference / separation of the plates

items.prompt: Write the word equation for Coulomb's law.
items.answer: electric force = charge 1 x charge 2 / (4 x pi x epsilon zero x distance squared)

items.term: Field strength of a point charge
items.prompt: Write the word equation for field strength of a point charge.
items.answer: electric field strength = charge / (4 x pi x epsilon zero x distance squared)

items.prompt: Write the word equation for electric potential.
items.answer: electric potential = charge / (4 x pi x epsilon zero x distance)

items.prompt: Write the word equation for electric potential energy.
items.answer: electric potential energy = charge 1 x charge 2 / (4 x pi x epsilon zero x distance)

items.prompt: Write the word equation for capacitance.
items.answer: capacitance = charge / potential difference

items.prompt: Write the word equation for energy stored in a capacitor.
items.answer: energy stored = 1/2 x charge x potential difference

items.prompt: Write the word equation for capacitors in series.
items.answer: 1 / total capacitance = sum of 1 / each capacitance

items.prompt: Write the word equation for capacitors in parallel.
items.answer: total capacitance = sum of the individual capacitances

items.prompt: Write the word equation for time constant.
items.answer: time constant = resistance x capacitance

items.prompt: Write the word equation for capacitor discharge.
items.answer: quantity = initial quantity x e to the power (- time / time constant)

items.prompt: Write the word equation for force on a current-carrying wire.
items.answer: force = flux density x current x length x sin(angle)

items.prompt: Write the word equation for force on a moving charge.
items.answer: force = flux density x charge x speed x sin(angle)

items.prompt: Write the word equation for Hall voltage.
items.answer: Hall voltage = flux density x current / (number density x thickness x charge)

items.prompt: Write the word equation for velocity selection.
items.answer: speed = electric field strength / magnetic flux density

items.prompt: Write the word equation for magnetic flux.
items.answer: magnetic flux = flux density x area perpendicular to the field

items.prompt: Write the word equation for magnetic flux linkage.
items.answer: flux linkage = number of turns x magnetic flux

items.prompt: Write the word equation for Faraday's and Lenz's laws.
items.answer: induced e.m.f. = - rate of change of magnetic flux linkage

items.prompt: Write the word equation for r.m.s. current.
items.answer: r.m.s. current = peak current / square root of 2

items.prompt: Write the word equation for r.m.s. voltage.
items.answer: r.m.s. voltage = peak voltage / square root of 2

items.prompt: Write the word equation for mean power in a resistor.
items.answer: mean power = 1/2 x peak power

items.prompt: Write the word equation for photon energy.
items.answer: photon energy = Planck constant x frequency

items.prompt: Write the word equation for photon energy and wavelength.
items.answer: photon energy = Planck constant x speed of light / wavelength

items.prompt: Write the word equation for photon momentum.
items.answer: photon momentum = photon energy / speed of light

items.prompt: Write the word equation for photoelectric equation.
items.answer: photon energy = work function + maximum kinetic energy of the photoelectron

items.prompt: Write the word equation for de Broglie wavelength.
items.answer: de Broglie wavelength = Planck constant / momentum

items.prompt: Write the word equation for energy level transition.
items.answer: photon energy = higher energy level - lower energy level

items.prompt: Write the word equation for mass-energy equivalence.
items.answer: energy = mass x speed of light squared

items.prompt: Write the word equation for activity.
items.answer: activity = decay constant x number of undecayed nuclei

items.prompt: Write the word equation for decay constant and half-life.
items.answer: decay constant = 0.693 / half-life

items.prompt: Write the word equation for radioactive decay.
items.answer: quantity remaining = initial quantity x e to the power (- decay constant x time)

items.prompt: Write the word equation for specific acoustic impedance.
items.answer: specific acoustic impedance = density x speed of sound

items.prompt: Write the word equation for intensity reflection coefficient.
items.answer: intensity reflection coefficient = (Z2 - Z1) squared / (Z2 + Z1) squared

items.prompt: Write the word equation for attenuation.
items.answer: transmitted intensity = initial intensity x e to the power (- attenuation coefficient x thickness)

items.prompt: Write the word equation for radiant flux intensity.
items.answer: radiant flux intensity = luminosity / (4 x pi x distance squared)

items.prompt: Write the word equation for Stefan-Boltzmann law.
items.answer: luminosity = 4 x pi x Stefan-Boltzmann constant x radius squared x temperature to the power 4

items.prompt: Write the word equation for Wien's displacement law.
items.answer: peak wavelength is inversely proportional to thermodynamic temperature

items.prompt: Write the word equation for redshift.
items.answer: change in wavelength / wavelength = recession speed / speed of light
items.formula: Δλ / λ ≈ Δf / f ≈ v / c

items.prompt: Write the word equation for Hubble's law.
items.answer: recession speed = Hubble constant x distance
